messages.subject: Project Cedar - board approval obtained
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Sarah,

The board approved the acquisition this morning on the terms reported, including the 25% warranty cap. Daniel and Rebecca are authorised to sign. Please proceed to exchange on 21 November and completion 12 December. Board minutes to follow from Priya Sandhu.

Isla
